issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as returning a String, while the reference solution implements getTotalNumberOfStudents() to return an int. This mismatch can confuse students: the textual task even points them to the UML for the expected return type, so students may implement a String-returning method while the solution and typical numeric semantics suggest an int.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Preferably update the UML and problem text to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (since it computes a numeric total), or alternatively change the solution to return a String if that was intended. Ensure the template method TODO/signature guidance matches the chosen return type so students implement the correct signature.
